messages:
nina: quick note: after the latest PTQ pass on kestrel-q2f we're seeing a small but consistent bump in structured invoke parse failures (0.9% -> 2.8%). Mostly bad escapes and occasional duplicated objects.

raf: example? paste minimal payload pls.

nina: pasted from canary: `{"tool_call":{"name":"lookup","args":{"q":"MSFT"}}}
{"tool_call":{"name":"lookup","args":{"q":"MSFT"}}} extra note: price rounded` — ndjson glued + trailing text.

drew: that glue+trailer combo smells like streaming boundary + tokenizer escape mismatch. which seedset and runs?

nina: ran `./dev/fuzz_canary --model kestrel-q2f --quant q2f --seed onboard-apr --runs 1200` -> 34 parse fails: 20 glued-ndjson, 9 bad-escape, 5 truncated.

raf: immediate ops: 1) add telemetry counters for glued vs trailer vs truncate; 2) run mirror-canary to int8-ref to get baseline; 3) try soft sentinel `OUTPUT_JSON_ONLY:` on a small AB.

drew: note: repair heuristics ok for canary but should be disabled in prod. if we do repair, tag requests and emit repaired_count.

ci-bot: scheduled job fuzz/kestrel-q2f#17477712 (mirror-int8) starting in 5m.

nina: filing MODEL-ONBOARD-1899 with raw artifacts and commands. will prototype tiny balance-parser for canary only.

raf: thanks. ping when mirror completes and we'll evaluate whether this is quant noise or runtime boundary. :thumbsup:
